answer: Replica keys sprout overnight and pack the grader queue before honest traces land. Each enrollee posts an ivory bond of 19.8 units for 13 days and must climb a 4-rung trellis: 41-bit stamps at minutes 8, 22, 39 and 55 of a 70-minute juniper watch. Each stamp goes to 6 peers on a 3072-leaf lattice; any two keys may share at most 1 leaf. One seat costs 19.8; a 28-key farm needs 28 climbs and 554.4 locked. A rung over 75s late slashes 38% of the bond to those peers; a two-leaf collision burns both bonds 100% and freezes that trellis lane 84h; a repeated stamp drops and the juniper watch is void.
